author: Jochelle Mendonca
body:
BANGALORE: Infosys’ head of design Sanjay Rajagopalan said he has left the company on professional networking website LinkedIn, a month after former CEO Vishal Sikka resign.

Sikka had brought in Rajagopalan from German software giant SAP.

Rajagopalan’s LinkedIn profile now says he is a ‘Free Man.’ He was one of the first SAP executives to follow Sikka to Infosys.

This is the first former-SAP executive to leave Infosys since Sikka’s resignation. Yusuf Bashir, who headed the company’s venture investments, and Ritika Suri, who headed large deals, also left the company earlier this year.

Analysts expect more senior exits as Infosys reviews Sikka’s strategy and brings in a new CEO.

title: After Sikka, Infosys’ design head Sanjay Rajagopalan quits
